items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts, replace bolts and gasket
items.note: Price is per side. If the manifold is warped and must be replaced, parts cost more.

items.t: HEMI lifter tick and camshaft wear
items.note: Heads come off for this job, so gaskets and head bolts are included. If metal spread through the engine, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Left cylinder head valve seat wear (3.6L)
items.note: Many affected engines got an extended head warranty. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.
Recall repair is free for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler gaskets
items.note: The intake manifold comes off for this job. Updated aluminum housings resist cracking better.

items.job: Replace rocker arms and lash adjusters, both banks
items.note: If a camshaft is worn too, expect more.

items.t: Loose front driveshaft bolts on AWD (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front driveshaft bolts
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Cruise control may not turn off (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Side curtain air bag inflators can rupture (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Oil sludge and internal coolant leak can ruin the engine (2.7L)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 2.7L
items.note: If caught early, a water pump replacement may be enough. A seized engine needs replacing.

items.t: Worn front tension struts, ball joints and tie rods
items.job: Replace front tension struts and align
items.note: Price is for both sides plus alignment. If ball joints or tie rods are worn too, expect more.

items.t: Car can roll away if not fully in Park (shifter recall)
items.job: Software update adding automatic Park feature
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
